Hi guys.

So I’ve created a Patreon page. It’s another way that I thought for supporting my work with textures.

HEAD TO PATREON FOR SUPPORT

Now you can choose between Patreon and Ko-fi to support me. But there are a few differences between the two sites:

  • With Ko-fi you buy me a coffee and in appreciation for your support I provide a link to my textures folder and you can easily download them all.
  • With Patreon there are 4 tiers and each tier gives you different levels of appreciation from me:
    • Tier 1: Discord Access
      • Join the exclusive 3dtextures.me Discord community and connect with other digital artists and designers.
      • Access to my public Discord channel: https://discord.gg/ms6KVMD

      Tier 2: Texture Library Access

      • Get exclusive access to my Google Drive folder with all my textures from 3dtextures.me. Download everything with just one click!
      • Request custom textures according to my availability.
      • Participate in the development process by suggesting new texture ideas on our Trello board.

      Tier 3: High Resolution Textures

      • Receive all rewards from Tier 1 and 2.
      • Enjoy exclusive access to my high-resolution textures (2K and 4K textures in uncompressed PNG format) + SBS and SBSAR files when available.
      • Request custom textures according to my availability.

      Tier 4: Texture Pack Access

      • Receive all rewards from Tier 1, 2 and 3.
      • Get access to my Texture Pack Volume 1 (100 seamless textures with diffuse, normal, occlusion, displacement, gloss/roughness and specular maps).
      • Stay up-to-date with my future Texture Packs.
      • Explore my photogrammetry models and tests.
      • Request custom textures with priority over other tiers.

Take care guys, keep doing great art and thank you for your support.
